**The University of Jordan**  
**الجامعة الأردنية**

| Course Number | Course Title                                              | Credit Hours |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0451315       | The methods of Eloquence and Elucidation in the Holy Quran (1) | 3            |

**Prerequisites:**  
Course Description:  
This course deals with the methods of Eloquence and Elucidation in the Holy Qur'an in terms of the language of the Qur'an, whether these characteristics are intrinsic or acquired (characteristics of a good and effective style), and the study of some methods in the Holy Qur'an, including: Presentation and delay, definition and denial, deletion and mention, separation and connection. A practical study in which the student tastes the splendor of the text and the accuracy of the meaning, as well as the study of evidence from the Book and the Sunnah. A practical study that is not limited when the rhetoricians decided through the study of these methods, during which the student sees the Qur'anic masterpieces.

---

| Course Number | Course Title                                              | Credit Hours |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0401415       | The methods of Eloquence and Elucidation in the Holy Quran (2) | 3            |

**Prerequisites:** 0451315  
Course Description:  
This course deals with simile and its types, metaphor and its types and relationships, metaphor and its types, the definition of the science of Badi'ah and verbal and moral enhancements, and the study of applied evidence from the Book and the Sunnah in relation to the topics of these sciences.

---

| Course Number | Course Title                             | Credit Hours |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0441321       | Hadith Accounts of al-Sahihayn         | 3            |

**Prerequisites:**  
Course Description:  
This course is basically concerned with a general study for the topics of the two sound authentic books of Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim. It then concentrates on a chosen collection to help the student gain special skills in dealing with the right approach of check-editing of prophetic sayings and special linguistic skills. Finally, it highlights the practical application for the methodology of Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim in their books.
